text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: dedicated-resv-west-1 queue depth > 95% for 6m, autoscaler in deadzone (max_replicas=24). Affected tenants: several enterprise reservations.

miguel_oncall: I'm on it, taking pager. tagging @sarah_eng and @eva_sre.

sarah_eng: looking at metrics — queue growth is steady, token latency spiking 3x. autoscaler shows repeated 'quota_exceeded' when trying to provision.

eva_sre: seeing noisy-tenant pattern on GPU host group resv-west-1-g2. Top sessions are long-running batch evals from OrchidBank-resv.

miguel_oncall: customer-impact check: any 5xxs or errors surfaced to customers?

liz_custsuccess: OrchidBank reported elevated latencies to support 10m ago, some requests timing out to their internal SLAs. They're on reserved capacity.

kevin_ops: infra note: cloud provider rate-limited instance creation after repeated scale attempts, backoff windows hit. Provisioning API returning 429.

raj_platform: autoscaler config snippet (from cluster):
```
policy: cpu_mem_scaled
minReplicas: 6
maxReplicas: 24
scaleCooldown: 30s
provisionBackoff: true
```

raj_platform: looks like maxReplicas capped too low for current sustained load and provisionBackoff prevented retries.

janet_lead: quick mitigation options? what can we do without a long infra request?

sarah_eng: possible mitigations: 1) burst-shed non-reserved sessions (best-effort) 2) evict long-running noisy sessions on reserved hosts 3) route some traffic to compatible hosted models as fallback.

miguel_oncall: evicting noisy sessions now -> will target sessions > 20m on hosts resv-west-1-g2.

incident-bot: action_logged: miguel_oncall evict_sessions --filter "duration>20m && tenant==OrchidBank"

kevin_ops: I've opened cloud support ticket CS-7892 to request emergency quota bump and sped up provisioning backoff. ETA from provider: 18-45m.

liz_custsuccess: informing OrchidBank with interim mitigation steps: we will evict long-running jobs and route lower-priority traffic to hosted fallback. asking for permission to terminate their non-critical runs.

raj_platform: applying temporary autoscaler patch: increase maxReplicas=40 and relax provisionBackoff for emergency. Pushing change now.

sarah_eng: patch applied to staging, smoke good. deploying to prod with 1m canary.

miguel_oncall: prod patch pushed. autoscaler attempted scale -> still getting 429s, but new logic allows more aggressive retry. queue depth dropping slowly.

kevin_ops: cloud told us they started quota update, new capacity showing as pending. Provisioning throughput increased slightly.

janet_lead: good. continue mitigation and track customer impact. assign postmortem owner.

miguel_oncall: postmortem owner: @sarah_eng. timeline notes capture: initial detection, evictions, autoscaler patch, provider quota request.

sarah_eng: filing initial incident doc. immediate action items:
- formalize burst-shed policy for reserved pools
- add autoscaler emergency mode (bypass slow backoff for tiered-reserved)
- improve noisy-tenant detection and proactive evictions

liz_custsuccess: OrchidBank acknowledged the mitigation and will re-run critical batches after we confirm steady state. They're asking for SLA credit estimate.

miguel_oncall: current status: queue depth at 62%, token latency back within 1.2x baseline, OrchidBank partial degradation but no hard failures now. Keeping pager open until queue <50% for 30m.

eva_sre: leaving logs snippet of evicted sessions for audit:
```
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] evict session id=abc123 tenant=OrchidBank duration=00:27:34 host=resv-west-1-g2
[2026-03-17T02:16:03Z] evict session id=def456 tenant=OrchidBank duration=00:49:10 host=resv-west-1-g2
```

raj_platform: follow-ups: request to infra to allow manual transient scale to 60 replicas in emergency, and to expose provider quota errors in autoscaler metrics.

kevin_ops: proceeding with provider escalation for a hard quota increase; tracking CS-7892.

miguel_oncall: leaving note: if provider doesn't finish quota bump, next step is to shift some enterprise reservations to other regions (resv-eu-1 or resv-us-east) — needs coordination with sales and customers.

janet_lead: agreed. @liz_custsuccess coordinate with OrchidBank and sales on fallback region options.

incident-bot: incident_state: mitigated -> monitoring (pager remains open). next_update in 15m.

miguel_oncall: thanks team. continuing to monitor and will post TL;DR and RCA owner in 1h. :thumbsup:

sarah_eng: I captured a list of noisy session signatures and will include mitigations in the postmortem. planning follow-up doc with timeline and config diffs.

liz_custsuccess: I'll prepare customer impact summary for SLA team.

kevin_ops: CS-7892 updated: provider accepted temporary quota bump, some instances created. provisioning error rate down from 60%->12%.

miguel_oncall: last check: queue 48%, closing pager if stable 30m. leaving thread for heads-up.

incident-bot: incident_closed_condition: queue < 50% for 30m OR manual close by oncall."
